function v_u_1.PlayerJoined(_, p_u_90) -- name: PlayerJoined
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_22
	local v91 = p_u_90:GetJoinData().TeleportData
	local v92 = v_u_6:GetPlayerData(p_u_90)
	local v93
	if v91 and typeof(v91) == "table" then
		v93 = v91.gameanalyticsData
		if v93 then
			local v94 = v91.gameanalyticsData
			local v95 = p_u_90.UserId
			v93 = v94[tostring(v95)]
		end
	else
		v93 = nil
	end
	local v96 = v_u_6:GetPlayerDataFromCache(p_u_90.UserId)
	if v96 then
		if v93 then
			v96.SessionID = v93.SessionID
			v96.SessionStart = v93.SessionStart
		end
		v96.PlayerTeleporting = false
	else
		local v97, v98 = v_u_15.invokeClient("getPlatform", p_u_90, 5)
		local v99 = not v97 and "unknown" or v98
		for v100, v101 in pairs(v_u_6.BasePlayerData) do
			if v92[v100] then
				continue
			end
			if typeof(v101) == "table" then
				v92[v100] = v_u_8:copyTable(v101)
			else
				v92[v100] = v101
			end
		end
		local function v102()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_13, (copy) p_u_90
			return v_u_13:GetCountryRegionForPlayerAsync(p_u_90)
		end
		local v103, v104 = pcall(v102)
		if v103 then
			v92.CountryCode = v104
		end
		v_u_6.PlayerCache[p_u_90.UserId] = v92
		local v105
		if v99 == "Console" then
			v105 = "uwp_console"
		elseif v99 == "Mobile" then
			v105 = "uwp_mobile"
		else
			local _ = v99 == "Desktop"
			v105 = "uwp_desktop"
		end
		v92.Platform = v105
		v92.OS = v92.Platform .. " 0.0.0"
		if not v103 then
			v_u_7:addSdkErrorEvent(p_u_90.UserId, "event_validation", "player_joined", "string_empty_or_null", "country_code", "")
		end
		local v106 = ""
		local v107
		if v_u_4.UseCustomUserId then
			local v108
			v108, v107 = v_u_15.invokeClient("getCustomUserId", p_u_90, 5)
			if not v108 then
				v107 = v106
			end
		else
			v107 = v106
		end
		if not v_u_8:isStringNullOrEmpty(v107) then
			v_u_2:i("Using custom id: " .. v107)
			v92.CustomUserId = v107
		end
		v_u_1:startNewSession(p_u_90, v93)

					end

end

function v10._MapConstructionData(p295)
	local v296 = {}
	local v297 = p295._containerDefaultAbsoluteSize
	local v298 = p295._constructionMarkups
	if v298 and v297 then
		for v299, v300 in pairs(p295._constructionData.rowEntries) do
			if not v296[v300.rowIndex] then
				local v301 = p295._constructionData.rows[v300.rowIndex]
				local v302 = 0
				for v303, v304 in ipairs(p295._constructionData.rows) do
					if v303 >= v300.rowIndex then
						break
					end
					v302 = v302 + v304.height
				end
				v296[v300.rowIndex] = {
					["height"] = v301.height,
					["rowEntries"] = {},
					["positionY"] = v302,
					["width"] = v301.width,
					["rowEntryIndices"] = {}
				}
			end
			local v305 = v296[v300.rowIndex].rowEntries
			local v306 = {
				["str"] = nil,
				["width"] = nil,
				["height"] = nil,
				["rowIndex"] = nil,
				["index"] = nil,
				["positionX"] = 0,
				["str"] = v300.str,
				["width"] = v300.width,
				["height"] = v300.height,
				["rowIndex"] = v300.rowIndex,
				["index"] = v299
			}
			table.insert(v305, v306)
			local v307 = v296[v300.rowIndex].rowEntryIndices
			table.insert(v307, v299)
		end
		for _, v308 in pairs(v296) do
			table.sort(v308.rowEntries, function(p309, p310)
				return p309.index < p310.index
			end)
			local v311 = 0
			for v312 = v298.horizontalAlignment.value == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right and (#v308.rowEntries or 1) or 1, v298.horizontalAlignment.value == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right and 1 or #v308.rowEntries, v298.horizontalAlignment.value == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right and -1 or 1 do
				local v313 = v308.rowEntries[v312]
				v313.positionX = v298.horizontalAlignment.value == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left and v311 or v298.horizontalAlignment.value == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right and v297.X - v311 - v313.width or v308.width > 0 and (v311 > 0 and (v311 / v308.width - 0.5) * v308.width + v297.X / 2 or v297.X / 2 - v308.width / 2) or v297.X / 2
				v311 = v311 + v313.width
			end
		end
		p295._mappedConstructionData = v296
	end
end
function v10._InitSpanData(p314)
	local v315 = p314._mappedConstructionData
	if v315 then
		for _, v316 in pairs(p314._constructionData.spans) do
			for _, v317 in ipairs(v316) do
				local v318 = {}
				local v319 = (1 / 0)
				local v320 = (-1 / 0)
				for _, v321 in ipairs(v317.rowEntryIndices) do
					for _, v322 in pairs(v315) do
						if not table.find(v322.rowEntryIndices, v321) then
							continue
						end
						if table.find(v318, v322) then
							break
						end
						table.insert(v318, v322)
						for _, v323 in ipairs(v322.rowEntries) do
							if not table.find(v317.rowEntryIndices, v323.index) then
								continue
							end
							if v323.positionX < v319 then
								v319 = v323.positionX
							end
							if v320 >= v323.positionX + v323.width then
								continue
							end
							v320 = v323.positionX + v323.width
						end
					end
				end
				if #v318 <= 0 then
					break
				end
				local v324 = 0
				if #v318 == 1 then
					v324 = 0
					for _, v325 in ipairs(v318[1].rowEntries) do
						if v324 >= v325.height or not table.find(v317.rowEntryIndices, v325.index) then
							continue
						end
						v324 = v325.height
					end
				elseif #v318 > 1 then
					local v326 = v318[#v318]
					local v327 = v318[1]
					local v328 = v326.positionY + v326.height / 2 - (v327.positionY + v327.height / 2)
					for _, v329 in ipairs({ v326, v327 }) do
						local v330 = 0
						for _, v331 in ipairs(v329.rowEntries) do
							if v330 >= v331.height or not table.find(v317.rowEntryIndices, v331.index) then
								continue
							end
							v330 = v331.height
						end
						v324 = v324 + v330 / 2
					end
					v324 = v324 + v328
				end
				local v332 = v318[1]
				local v333 = 0
				for _, v334 in ipairs(v332.rowEntries) do
					if v333 >= v334.height or not table.find(v317.rowEntryIndices, v334.index) then
						continue
					end
					v333 = v334.height
				end
				v317.position = Vector2.new(v319, v332.positionY + v332.height / 2 - v333 / 2)
				v317.size = Vector2.new(v320 - v319, v324)
			end
		end
	end
end
function v10._GetRowEntryPosition(p335, p336)
	if p335._mappedConstructionData then

		end

end

function v10._ParseText(p_u_389)

	local v390 = p_u_389._text
	local v391 = p_u_389._renderTraceback
	if v390 and v391 then
		local v392 = {}
		local v_u_393 = 1
		local v_u_394 = {}
		local v395 = {}
		for _, v396 in ipairs(v_u_7) do
			if v396.type ~= "paired" or not v396.stackable then
				continue
			end
			local v397 = p_u_389._constructionMarkups[v396.name].stack
			v392[v396.name] = 0
			for _, v398 in pairs(v397) do

				if v404 then

					end)
					p_u_389._constructionScheduler:Append(function()
						-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_389, (copy) v_u_400, (copy) v_u_393
						p_u_389:_AppendStringToCurrentWord(v_u_400, v_u_393)
					end, 2)

						-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_389

										p_u_389._constructionScheduler:Append(function()

	describe("Promise:cancel", function()

		it("should wait for all promises to be resolved and return their values", function()

			local v228, v229, v230 = unpack(v227, 1, v226)
			expect(v226).to.equal(3)
			expect(v228).to.equal(false)
			expect(v229).to.equal("foo")
			expect(v230).to.equal("bar")
		end)
		it("should error if a non-array table is passed in", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local function v231()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				v_u_1.all(v_u_1.new(function() end))
			end
			local v232, v233 = pcall(v231)
			expect(v232).to.be.ok()
			expect(v233:find("Non%-promise")).to.be.ok()
		end)
		it("should cancel pending promises if one rejects", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v234 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			expect(v_u_1.all({ v_u_1.resolve(), v_u_1.reject(), v234 }):getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v234:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)
		it("should cancel promises if it is cancelled", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v235 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			v235:andThen(function() end)
			local v236 = { v_u_1.new(function() end), v_u_1.new(function() end), v235 }
			v_u_1.all(v236):cancel()
			expect(v236[1]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v236[2]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v236[3]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.fold", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
		it("should return the initial value in a promise when the list is empty", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v237 = {}
			local v238 = v_u_1.fold({}, function()
				error("should not be called")
			end, v237)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v238)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v238:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v238:expect()).to.equal(v237)
		end)
		it("should accept promises in the list", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_239 = nil
			local v243 = v_u_1.fold({ v_u_1.new(function(p240)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_239
					v_u_239 = p240
				end), 2, 3 }, function(p241, p242)
				return p241 + p242
			end, 0)
			v_u_239(1)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v243)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v243:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v243:expect()).to.equal(6)
		end)
		it("should always return a promise even if the list or reducer don\'t use them", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
			local v247 = v_u_1.fold({ 1, 2, 3 }, function(p244, p245, p246)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				if p246 == 2 then
					return v_u_1.delay(1):andThenReturn(p244 + p245)
				else
					return p244 + p245
				end
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v247)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v247:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_6(2)
			expect(v247:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v247:expect()).to.equal(6)
		end)
		it("should return the first rejected promise", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v251 = v_u_1.fold({ 1, 2, 3 }, function(p248, p249, p250)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				if p250 == 2 then
					return v_u_1.reject("foo")
				else
					return p248 + p249
				end
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v251)).to.equal(true)
			local v252, v253 = v251:awaitStatus()
			expect(v252).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v253).to.equal("foo")
		end)
		it("should return the first canceled promise", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_254 = nil
			local v258 = v_u_1.fold({ 1, 2, 3 }, function(p255, p256, p257)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_254, (ref) v_u_1
				if p257 == 1 then
					return p255 + p256
				end
				if p257 == 2 then
					v_u_254 = v_u_1.delay(1):andThenReturn(p255 + p256)
					return v_u_254
				end
				error("this should not run if the promise is cancelled")
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v258)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v258:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_254:cancel()
			expect(v258:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.race", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should resolve with the first settled value", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			expect(v263[2]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v263[3]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)

			expect(v265:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)

	describe("Promise.tap", function()

		end)
	end)

	describe("Promise.some", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should resolve once the goal is reached", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			expect(v306:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v306._values[1][1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v306._values[1][2]).to.equal(2)

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			local v_u_307 = nil
			local v309 = v_u_1.some({ v_u_1.resolve(), v_u_1.new(function(_, p308)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_307
					v_u_307 = p308

			expect(v309:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)

			expect(v309:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)

		end)
		it("should cancel pending Promises once the goal is reached", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_310 = nil
			local v311 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			local v313 = v_u_1.new(function(p312)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_310
				v_u_310 = p312
			end)
			local v314 = v_u_1.some({ v311, v313, v_u_1.resolve() }, 2)
			expect(v314:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v311:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v313:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_310()
			expect(v314:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v311:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v313:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
		end)

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			end).to.throw()
		end)
		it("should return an empty array if amount is 0", function()

	describe("Promise.each", function()

			end):_unwrap()
			expect(v342).to.equal(true)

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22
	if v_u_20 then
		v_u_20:Disconnect()
		v_u_20 = nil
	end
	if v_u_21 then
		v_u_21:Disconnect()
		v_u_21 = nil
	end
	if v_u_22 then
		v_u_22:Disconnect()
		v_u_22 = nil
	end
end
function teardownManager() -- name: teardownManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	resetManagerListeners()
	v_u_23 = nil
	v_u_24 = nil
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22
	if p_u_28.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_24 ~= p_u_28 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_23 = p_u_28.GroundSensor
		v_u_20 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_20
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_20:Disconnect()
				v_u_20 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_21
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_21:Disconnect()
				v_u_21 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_22 = p_u_28.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p29)
			if p29 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_24 = p_u_28
	end
	return true
end
function setupManager(p_u_30) -- name: setupManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_22
	v_u_24 = p_u_30
	v_u_23 = p_u_30.GroundSensor
	v_u_20 = p_u_30:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
		v_u_23 = v_u_24.GroundSensor
	end)
	v_u_21 = p_u_30:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (ref) v_u_1
		if p_u_30.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
	v_u_22 = p_u_30.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p31)
		if p31 == nil then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	if v_u_27 then
		local v_u_32 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v_u_32 then
			if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
				setupManager(v_u_32)
			else
				local v_u_33 = nil
				v_u_33 = v_u_32:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_33
					if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
						v_u_33:Disconnect()
						setupManager(v_u_32)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			local v_u_34 = nil
			v_u_34 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p35)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34
				if p35:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					v_u_34:Disconnect()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
			return
		end
	else
		v_u_23 = nil
		v_u_24 = nil
		local v36 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v36 then
			processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v36)
		end
		if v_u_24 == nil then
			local v_u_37 = nil
			v_u_37 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p38)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_37
				if p38:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p38) then
					v_u_37:Disconnect()
					v_u_37 = nil
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
end

function configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43) -- name: configureAnimationSet

	if v_u_17[p_u_42] ~= nil then
		for _, v44 in pairs(v_u_17[p_u_42].connections) do
			v44:disconnect()
		end
	end
	v_u_17[p_u_42] = {}
	v_u_17[p_u_42].count = 0
	v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_17[p_u_42].connections = {}
	local v_u_45 = true
	local function v46()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_45
		v_u_45 = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").AllowCustomAnimations

	local v48 = script:FindFirstChild(p_u_42)

		local v51 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
		local v52 = v48.ChildRemoved

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)

		for _, v53 in pairs(v48:GetChildren()) do
			if not v53:IsA("Animation") then
				continue
			end

			local v55 = v54 == nil and 1 or v54.Value
			v_u_17[p_u_42].count = v_u_17[p_u_42].count + 1
			local v56 = v_u_17[p_u_42].count
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v56] = {}
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v56].anim = v53
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v56].weight = v55
			v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight = v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight + v_u_17[p_u_42][v56].weight
			local v57 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
			local v58 = v53.Changed
			table.insert(v57, v58:connect(function(_)
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
				configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
			end))
			local v59 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
			local v60 = v53.ChildAdded
			table.insert(v59, v60:connect(function(_)
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
				configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
			end))
			local v61 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
			local v62 = v53.ChildRemoved
			table.insert(v61, v62:connect(function(_)
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
				configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
			end))
		end
	end
	if v_u_17[p_u_42].count <= 0 then
		for v63, v64 in pairs(p_u_43) do
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v63] = {}
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v63].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v63].anim.Name = p_u_42
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v63].anim.AnimationId = v64.id

			v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight = v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight + v64.weight
		end
	end
	for _, v65 in pairs(v_u_17) do
		for v66 = 1, v65.count do
			if v_u_16[v65[v66].anim.AnimationId] ~= nil then
				continue
			end
			v_u_2:LoadAnimation(v65[v66].anim)
			v_u_16[v65[v66].anim.AnimationId] = true
		end
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v102 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v102 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v102
end
local function v_u_108(p103) -- name: setRunSpeed
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_14
	local v104 = p103 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v105 = 0.0001
	local v106 = 0.0001
	local v107 = 1
	if v104 <= 0.5 then
		v107 = v104 / 0.5
		v105 = 1
	elseif v104 < 1 then
		v106 = (v104 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v105 = 1 - v106
	else
		v107 = v104 / 1
		v106 = 1
	end
	v_u_11:AdjustWeight(v105)
	v_u_14:AdjustWeight(v106)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v107)
	v_u_14:AdjustSpeed(v107)
end

function rollAnimation(p114) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17
	local v115 = math.random(1, v_u_17[p114].totalWeight)
	local v116 = 1
	while v_u_17[p114][v116].weight < v115 do
		v115 = v115 - v_u_17[p114][v116].weight
		v116 = v116 + 1
	end
	return v116
end
local function v_u_122(p117, p118, p119, p120) -- name: switchToAnim

		if p118 == "walk" then

	end
end
